paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: Token Ratio (TR).
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the token ratio for several language models, comparing RedWhale to other models including EEVe-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-SN, KoBEST-BQ, and KoBEST-HS. The horizontal axis displays the model names, presented in alphabetical order, while the vertical axis represents the token ratio, ranging from 0.42 to 0.79, with values marked at regular intervals, such as 0.52, 0.56, 0.58, 0.69, 0.74, 0.79, and 0.86.  Each bar corresponds to a specific model and is colored blue; the RedWhale bar has a value of approximately 0.59, resulting in the tallest bar in the visualization. The EEVe-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 bar represents a token ratio of approximately 0.46, while the SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) bar is roughly 0.78. The KoBEST models – KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-SN, KoBEST-BQ, and KoBEST-HS – each have token ratios of approximately 0.58, 0.69, 0.69, and 0.74 respectively, and the average is represented by a bar with a token ratio of approximately 0.59. There are no bars visually emphasized or sorted in any particular order.
